races.name: South West Rail Solutions Ltd Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Crystal Island
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse facing unfavourable pace setup but carries Henderson/De Boinville class advantage and handles soft ground well
runners_data.comment: Irish point winner who impressed on rules debut at Ascot in December; good prospect
runners_data.spotlight: Joined Nicky Henderson after winning Irish point debut just over a year ago and impressed when beating useful rivals on rules debut at Ascot (2m5f, soft) in December; not seen since but remains a very good prospect.

runners_data.name: Home Made Hero
runners_data.note: Another hold-up runner with solid RPR 124 but needs luck in running from this tactical position given the race shape
runners_data.comment: Good winner on hurdle debut in October but might have to settle for a minor role here
runners_data.spotlight: Drew 12l clear to make winning rules debut at Uttoxeter (2m4f, good to soft) in October and also ran well on next two outings, albeit a late faller on first occasion; might have to settle for a minor role in this deep race, though.

runners_data.name: Dylans Moon
runners_data.note: Hold-up style on hurdles debut, inexperienced but light weight and room for improvement from Ellis yard
runners_data.comment: Made pleasing debut when third at Uttoxeter last month but needs a good step forward here
runners_data.spotlight: Made pleasing debut when third of nine in Uttoxeter novice hurdle (2m4f, soft) last month and has obvious scope for improvement but needs to take a good step forward here.

runners_data.name: Kings Champion
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner with Bowen up, solid soft ground form but 77 days off and needs to handle the early pressure from Rathkenny

runners_data.name: Fairye Forth
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with 5lb claimer reducing to 159lbs, recent Ffos Las experience 19 days ago could be key advantage

runners_data.name: Uptown Dandy
runners_data.note: Course and distance winner last time in heavy conditions, prominent style suits the likely pace scenario perfectly
runners_data.comment: Fairly useful form when winning C&D maiden last month; probably needs more again today
runners_data.spotlight: Delivered on earlier promise when winning C&D (heavy) maiden last month, recovering well from slow jump at third-last flight; ran to fairly useful level that day but probably needs to improve again to land this prize.

runners_data.name: Pappariche
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with fade-in-finish warning, 100-1 shot on recent C&D debut suggests limited ability in this grade
runners_data.comment: Well-beaten 100-1 shot over C&D on rules debut nine days ago
runners_data.spotlight: Won a small-field Irish point last February (heavy ground) but was well-beaten 100-1 shot over C&D on rules debut nine days ago.

runners_data.name: Rathkenny
runners_data.note: Front-running style but pulled up last time at Sandown, needs to bounce back but has winning Doncaster soft ground form
runners_data.comment: Pulled up in competitive handicap last time but looked promising beforehand; e-w claims
runners_data.spotlight: Pulled up in last month's EBF Final at Sandown but looked promising beforehand, most notably when winning Doncaster maiden (2m3f, soft) in January; each-way claims if back on song.

runners_data.name: Axel Bleue
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning from 165-day break, dual bumper winner but long absence is major concern in competitive heat
runners_data.comment: Fair form when second twice in October but absent since pulled up in November; tough task
runners_data.spotlight: Point and dual bumper winner in 2025; fair form when runner-up in two 2m7f novice hurdles in October but absent since pulled up on handicap debut in November and faces tough assignment here.

runners_data.name: Malinaero
runners_data.note: Prominent style but limited form figures and 0/12 trainer record over past fortnight suggests minimal chance
runners_data.comment: Showed only minor promise on first two outings (bumper/2m3f hurdle)
runners_data.spotlight: Showed only minor promise on first two outings (bumper/2m3f hurdle) and cannot be recommended in this company.

runners_data.name: Cedar Creek
runners_data.note: Bumper winner making hurdles debut after 475-day absence, prominent style suits but massive fitness question
runners_data.comment: Promising in bumpers last season but makes hurdle debut after long layoff and in good race
runners_data.spotlight: Flat-bred 5yo who won good-ground junior bumper at Aintree in November 2024 and was not disgraced in Cheltenham Listed event a few weeks later; makes hurdle debut after 475-day absence and in a strong race, though.

runners_data.name: Yellow Card
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with poor recent form and 200-day absence, totally out of his depth in this company

races.paceDynamic: Kings Champion and Rathkenny will contest the early lead, with Kings Champion likely to dictate given Sean Bowen's positive approach and the horse's front-running style. Five horses wanting prominent positions (Fairye Forth, Uptown Dandy, Axel Bleue, Malinaero, Cedar Creek) will create congestion and potential interference 2-3 out when the race begins in earnest. The honest gallop set by the two leaders over this stamina-sapping 2m4f on soft ground will stretch the field, making it difficult for hold-up horses to close from the back. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers and front-runners who can avoid the mid-race traffic and maintain position turning for home.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Kings Champion or Rathkenny gets an uncontested lead and maintains rhythm
scenarios.body: The leader kicks clear approaching 2 out while prominent horses get shuffled back in traffic. Soft ground and stamina demands prevent hold-up horses from making up the ground.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Surge Late
scenarios.trigger: If the two leaders set too strong a pace and tire approaching the final flight
scenarios.body: Uptown Dandy or Fairye Forth benefit from tracking the pace without doing the donkey work early. They surge past tiring leaders in the final 100 yards as hold-up horses struggle to get into contention.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Henderson Quality Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If Crystal Island gets a clean run from the back despite the pace setup
scenarios.body: Crystal Island's superior class tells despite the unfavourable race shape, with Nico de Boinville timing his challenge perfectly. The soft ground aids his stamina and he powers through tired horses.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos Creates Upset
scenarios.trigger: If multiple fallers or major interference disrupts the prominent pack 2-3 out
scenarios.body: The congestion leads to significant trouble for the fancied runners leaving the race open for an outsider. Cedar Creek or Dylans Moon benefit from staying out of trouble and inherit the lead.

watchPoints.text: Kings Champion and Rathkenny clash early could set up strong pace that compromises both leaders in the straight
Prominent traffic jam featuring Uptown Dandy, Fairye Forth, Axel Bleue and Malinaero will create interference 2-3 flights out
Crystal Island needs significant luck in running as hold-up horse in race likely to favour forward positions throughout
Cedar Creek makes hurdles debut after 15+ month absence but won good Aintree bumper and could surprise at odds
Pappariche showed recent fade tendency and 100-1 debut suggests trainer expectations remain low despite course familiarity

races.name: SWRSL - Dan Boulton Novices' Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Smile Back
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with consistent placed efforts but 64 days off and not progressing, needs to prove fitness
runners_data.comment: Placed in three of her four handicaps but not making any progress; others appeal more
runners_data.spotlight: Placed in three of her four handicaps but was beaten about 19l when weakening third at Carlisle (3m1f, soft) in February and is not making any progress; hood left off here; stablemate Hidden Target appeals more.

runners_data.name: Stiletto
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer who won three times early season but needs to bounce back from disappointing return
runners_data.comment: Three wins in early part of season; probably needed last month's run; Bowen back aboard
runners_data.spotlight: Did well for new stable in early part of season, winning three times under Sean Bowen (2m2f-3m, good/good to soft); returned from break with low-key run last month but has the champion jockey back on board today.

runners_data.name: Hidden Target
runners_data.note: Hold-up type suited by step up in trip, 1lb lower than Chepstow third and Sheehan booking catches eye
runners_data.comment: Kept on for third at Chepstow (2m3f) last month and can improve again over 3m
runners_data.spotlight: Bettered low-key handicap debut when keeping-on third at Chepstow (2m3f, good to soft) last month; 1lb lower here and pedigree suggests this longer trip will suit; high on the list.

runners_data.name: Kastellion
runners_data.note: Prominent racer with solid form but yet to win over hurdles, needs to find extra gear

runners_data.name: Golden Prince
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with scope as 5-year-old, step up to 3m worked well at Bangor and still unexposed
runners_data.comment: Placed when upped to 2m7f for recent handicap debut and probably still has potential
runners_data.spotlight: Unexposed 5yo who was evidently suited by the hike up in trip when third on handicap debut at Bangor (2m7f, good) three weeks ago; probably still has potential; might be the answer.

runners_data.name: Air Apparent
runners_data.note: Only natural front-runner in field, will dictate terms but needs to prove stamina at this trip
runners_data.comment: Third in 2m3f maiden last month and open to more improvement in staying handicaps
runners_data.spotlight: Kept on for third in Hereford maiden (2m3f, good) last month, his fourth start over hurdles, and has plenty of scope for further improvement in staying handicaps; no surprise if he features.

runners_data.name: Eaststone Buck's
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer getting significant weight relief, Williams stable angle with promising young rider

runners_data.name: Fanny Moon
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse trying 3m for first time after struggling in handicap debut, needs major step forward
runners_data.comment: Unexposed after only four hurdle runs but was soundly beaten on handicap debut (2m3f)
runners_data.spotlight: Unexposed after only four hurdle runs but was soundly beaten on last month's handicap debut at Bangor (2m3f, good); goes beyond about 2m5f for first time here.

runners_data.name: Moon Over Clyro
runners_data.note: Hold-up type with fading tendency wearing cheekpieces, trip increase may not solve finishing issues
runners_data.comment: Struggled in first two handicaps (2m3f/2m2f); up in trip with cheekpieces added here
runners_data.spotlight: Placed in two 2m Worcester maidens towards end of last summer but struggled in his first two handicaps (2m3f/2m2f); hiked up in trip with cheekpieces added today; leap of faith required to support him.

runners_data.name: Getaway King
runners_data.note: Prominent racer returning from chase fall, proven winner but fitness concerns after layoff
runners_data.comment: Won three chases in the autumn; has cheekpieces added for this hurdling debut
runners_data.spotlight: Ex-Irish 8yo who started off for Fergal O'Brien with three chase wins (2m4f-2m5f) in the autumn; returned with a lesser effort in February and fell when last in action but remains unexposed over 3m; sports first-time cheekpieces for hurdling debut; could have a say.

runners_data.name: Washington Parks
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning after full year off, needs market support to suggest readiness
runners_data.comment: 0-6 over hurdles in Ireland and absent for a year but worth a market check on stable debut
runners_data.spotlight: 0-6 over hurdles when based in Ireland and absent since two down-the-field handicap runs last April (2m3f/2m4f), but still worth a glance in the betting before this stable debut; tongue-tie added.

runners_data.name: Dessie Haze
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer in form after Chepstow win 19 days ago, 6lb penalty offset by confidence boost
runners_data.comment: Stayed on well to beat well-handicapped, odds-on favourite at Chepstow this month
runners_data.spotlight: Beat well-handicapped, odds-on favourite when staying on well to open account at Chepstow (2m7f, good to soft) 19 days ago, his eighth start over hurdles; 6lb higher here but may yet have more to offer.

runners_data.name: Glenmuick
runners_data.note: Prominent racer with fading tendency trying cheekpieces, needs significant improvement from recent efforts
runners_data.comment: Soundly beaten in first three handicaps; up in trip with cheekpieces added today
runners_data.spotlight: Soundly beaten in first three handicap hurdles (2m-2m4f); needs combination of new trip and first-time cheekpieces to enable huge improvement.

races.paceDynamic: Air Apparent is the only confirmed front runner in this 13-runner field, likely to set a sustainable gallop without pressure from fellow pace-setters. Smile Back, Kastellion, Getaway King, Washington Parks and Glenmuick will settle prominently but none are natural leaders, creating a moderate tempo through the early stages. The lack of genuine pace competition means the race will develop into a staying test from the 2-out point, with hold-up horses like Stiletto, Hidden Target, Golden Prince and Dessie Haze getting every chance to mount late challenges. This race shape clearly favours hold-up horses who can benefit from the solid gallop and deliver their challenge late in the 3-mile trip.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Air Apparent sets uncontested fractions and the pace stays moderate through halfway
scenarios.body: The steady gallop plays perfectly into the hands of the back-markers who get the ideal setup to unleash finishing kicks. Hidden Target, Golden Prince, Dessie Haze and Stiletto all benefit from patient rides and soft ground conditions.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent racers prevail
scenarios.trigger: If the moderate pace becomes genuinely slow and finishing kicks are blunted
scenarios.body: Horses positioned closer to the pace gain a crucial advantage when the race fails to develop a strong gallop. Smile Back and Kastellion are best positioned to capitalize on their forward positioning when late closers can't generate enough momentum.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace collapse benefits closers
scenarios.trigger: If Air Apparent stops quickly and prominent horses fail to capitalize on weak fractions
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where the freshest finishers with the strongest recent form prevail. Dessie Haze's recent Chepstow win and Golden Prince's Bangor third put them in prime position to strike late.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise longshot strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the market principals underperform and the soft ground creates an upset
scenarios.body: Poor recent form from favorites opens the door for an improver or returning horse to capitalize. Washington Parks returning from a long absence or Eaststone Buck's getting a perfect ride from the Williams stable could cause a shock.

watchPoints.text: Air Apparent must prove stamina at 3m as only confirmed pace-setter, any signs of weakening 2-out opens race dramatically
Washington Parks market support crucial given 366-day absence, any betting move suggests hidden fitness
Hidden Target and Golden Prince both improving types stepping up in trip, track their market positions
Dessie Haze carries 6lb penalty from recent win but 19-day turnaround could catch softer opposition
Getaway King's fitness after chase fall and Stiletto's return to form both need monitoring in paddock

races.name: South West Rail Solutions Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Gaelic Rambler

runners_data.name: Bowenspark
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer who needs things to fall right but has proven class when on song
runners_data.comment: Good winner at Bangor in February but safely held since; cheekpieces given another whirl
runners_data.spotlight: Came good over fences with small-field win at Uttoxeter (2m4f, good to soft) in February but was not in the same form on his latest outing and ran poorly the only previous time he wore cheekpieces; others look safer.

runners_data.name: Brulure Noire
runners_data.note: Course specialist dropping 2lb from C&D second, concerning recent PU form but proven here
runners_data.comment: Failed to complete both races this season but was clear second over C&D a year ago
runners_data.spotlight: Three-time chase winner (twice here); has form-figures of PU during light campaign this season but is 2lb lower than when clear second over C&D (soft; also suited by good to soft) a year ago; can't be ruled out.

runners_data.name: Jeu d'Opale
runners_data.note: Front-running type freshened by 66-day break, 9lb rise for Wincanton win is significant test
runners_data.comment: Ready winner on heavy ground in February, his sixth British start; up 9lb
runners_data.spotlight: Ex-French 8yo who opened British account at sixth attempt, with ready success at Wincanton (2m4f, heavy) in February; 9lb higher here and may not want the ground to dry out too much but further progress is possible.

runners_data.name: Lermoos Legend
runners_data.note: Course winner returning after 189 days, five wins at this track but tough current mark
runners_data.comment: Runs this track very well but has been absent since October
runners_data.spotlight: Gained five of his nine chase wins at this track (2m/2m3f) but absent since below-par run in October and still on a fairly tough mark.

runners_data.name: Hold Up La Colmine
runners_data.note: Prominent runner wearing new cheekpieces, wide-margin Windsor winner but disappointing since
runners_data.comment: Wide-margin winner on seasonal debut but subsequent form underwhelming; cheekpieces added
runners_data.spotlight: Won by wide-margin on seasonal debut at Windsor (2m4f, good to soft) in November but subsequent hurdle/chase form has been underwhelming; needs new cheekpieces to provoke a response.

runners_data.name: Latenightrumble
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse on good mark but tends to jump left, needs strong pace to set up his challenge
runners_data.comment: Seemingly back in good form two starts ago; back in trip with new headgear tried here
runners_data.spotlight: On a good mark now and was seemingly back in good form when close fourth of 11 at Chepstow (2m7f, soft) in February; tended to jump left and was below that level without cheekpieces at Carlisle (3m) last month but has possibilities if combination of drop back in trip, first-time blinkers and return to a left-handed track has desired effect.

runners_data.name: Jaccours
runners_data.note: Hold-up type with solid soft ground record but 57 days off and no recent RPR figure

runners_data.name: Calli Black
runners_data.note: Front-runner returning after 132 days, lightweight but concerning recent form decline
runners_data.comment: Won at Worcester last spring but subsequent form was disappointing; back from a break
runners_data.spotlight: Won readily at Worcester (2m4f, good) last spring and is still lightly raced over fences but her subsequent three runs (latest was over hurdles) were disappointing and she's 2lb wrong on first outing since December.

races.paceDynamic: Jeu d'Opale and Calli Black will establish the early tempo, with Jeu d'Opale likely to dictate given his stronger recent form and fresher profile after 66 days off. The honest gallop they create should suit the prominent runners like Gaelic Rambler and Hold Up La Colmine, who can track the pace without needing to come from too far back. With soft ground demanding sustained stamina over this 2m3½f trip, horses making their moves from midfield positions will struggle to make up significant ground. This race shape clearly favours PROMINENT runners who can stay handy and avoid getting bogged down in traffic or having too much to do late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is honest but not punishing, allowing trackers to strike
scenarios.body: The front two will soften each other up enough for the prominent runners to take over entering the straight. Gaelic Rambler and Hold Up La Colmine have the tactical positioning and class to capitalize.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Jeu d'Opale gets his own way up front with measured fractions
scenarios.body: The 8-year-old can use his 66-day freshness advantage and strong Wincanton win to control the race from the front. His ability to quicken off steady pace makes him very dangerous despite the 9lb rise.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Success
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuinely strong and the leaders tie up badly
scenarios.body: The soft ground will take its toll on the pace-setters, allowing the patient hold-up horses to stay on strongly. Bowenspark and Lermoos Legend have the class to pick up the pieces if given racing room.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Course Specialist Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Lermoos Legend or Brulure Noire show improved form returning to Ffos Las
scenarios.body: The 189-day absence might have freshened Lermoos Legend, while Brulure Noire drops 2lb from his C&D second. Their intimate track knowledge becomes decisive in a tight finish.

watchPoints.text: Jeu d'Opale if allowed to control fractions unchallenged from the front, his Wincanton win was impressive
Lermoos Legend for market support given his 189-day absence but outstanding course record
Hold Up La Colmine for immediate response to new cheekpieces after underwhelming recent efforts
Early pace battle between Jeu d'Opale and Calli Black will set up the entire race dynamics
Gaelic Rambler for continued improvement after his recent consistent form surge

races.name: SWRSL - Alfie Boulton Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Caelan
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer returning after 120 days with strong soft ground form but needs the race to develop late
runners_data.comment: Returns from break on workable mark but Sean Bowen rides the stable's other one
runners_data.spotlight: Improved to win good-ground Worcester maiden (2m, good to soft) in September and subsequently made the frame in two 2m Huntington handicaps (good/good to soft); returns from four-month break on workable mark but riding arrangements suggest Trust House is the stable's main hope.

runners_data.name: Thankyouandplease
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse quick to reappear after Friday's solid second at Ayr, proven soft ground performer with fighting chance off career-high mark
runners_data.comment: Dual 1m7f winner this season; makes quick reappearance after 2m4f Ayr second on Friday
runners_data.spotlight: Dual 1m7f winner this season (heavy/good to soft); gave good account when second off today's career-high mark at Ayr (2m4f, soft) on Friday and has a fighting chance here, providing this race doesn't come too soon.

runners_data.name: Eastern Shores
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner who disappointed when stepped up in trip last time and not yet fully exposed according to spotlight
runners_data.comment: Second on handicap debut (2m) but disappointed when upped to 2m3f; more needed here
runners_data.spotlight: No match for winner when second on handicap debut at Huntingdon (2m, soft) in February and disappointed when upped to 2m3f at Bangor last month; not yet fully exposed but needs to find something extra here.

runners_data.name: Trust House
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who won readily at Market Rasen last time and has excellent record of 2-8 over hurdles for in-form Olly Murphy
runners_data.comment: Won readily at Market Rasen last month, his second run after a layoff; commands respect
runners_data.spotlight: Rewarded strong market support when winning readily at Market Rasen (2m, good to soft) last month, on his second run after a layoff, and is now 2-8 over hurdles; 8lb higher here but still commands respect.

runners_data.name: Aeroplane Blonde
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer with tendency to race too freely, 0-6 over hurdles but interesting despite 59-day absence

runners_data.spotlight: Has a tendency to race too freely and is usually held up at the back; struggled to get competitive at Chepstow in February and now 0-6 over hurdles but interesting if judged on some of his form towards the end of last year; not out of this if first-time cheekpieces have positive effect.

runners_data.name: Chillhi
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning after 187 days under new trainer Barry John Murphy, only pace angle but needs to prove fitness
runners_data.comment: Flat and dual hurdle winner last summer but makes stable debut after a layoff
runners_data.spotlight: Flat and dual hurdle winner during busy summer for James Owen last year but absent since two below-par runs for Alison Thorpe in October; considered only if lively in the market before this stable debut.

runners_data.name: Corner Forward
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse on bottom weight of 155lbs, poor recent form but could benefit from tactical scenario

runners_data.name: Asta La Vista
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who kept on for third last time, unexposed 5-year-old with scope for improvement on 151lbs
runners_data.comment: Kept on for modest third in Wetherby maiden last month; may progress again in handicaps
runners_data.spotlight: Unexposed 5yo who was well beaten in his first two hurdle races but kept on to take a modest third at Wetherby (2m, good) last month and has plenty of scope for further improvement in handicaps.

races.paceDynamic: Chillhi is the only confirmed front runner and will set a steady, uncontested lead from the start. With six hold-up horses (Caelan, Thankyouandplease, Eastern Shores, Trust House, Aeroplane Blonde, Corner Forward) and one prominent runner (Asta La Vista), the pace will be moderate early before quickening from the home turn. This creates a tactical advantage for hold-up horses who can time their challenges, as Chillhi may struggle to sustain his lead against the weight of numbers closing late. The race shape strongly favours hold-up performers who can quicken off the steady gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Chillhi sets his usual steady pace and the field bunches up turning for home
scenarios.body: The moderate early gallop plays perfectly into the hands of the six hold-up horses who can all get competitive in the straight. Trust House, Thankyouandplease and Caelan have the class to capitalize on this tactical scenario.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Chillhi Stays Strong
scenarios.trigger: If Chillhi gets an easy lead and finds more stamina than recent form suggests after his 187-day break
scenarios.body: The long absence could have freshened him up and his high TopSpeed of 104 gives him a fitness edge if he can sustain his gallop. Asta La Vista could emerge as the main challenger from his prominent position.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is too steady and the race becomes a sprint from the final flight
scenarios.body: A crawling pace would suit the horse with the best turn of foot rather than the strongest stayers. Eastern Shores and Aeroplane Blonde could benefit from a tactical affair despite their moderate recent form.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Meltdown
scenarios.trigger: If Chillhi goes too slow early and multiple horses challenge together from the back
scenarios.body: A messy, stop-start affair where the outsiders can get into contention through tactical positioning rather than ability. Corner Forward's light weight becomes more significant in a tactical dogfight.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Chillhi gets an uncontested lead and whether his 187-day absence shows in the final furlong when the hold-up horses challenge
Monitor Thankyouandplease for any signs of his quick turnaround from Friday's Ayr run affecting his finishing kick
Check if Trust House can reproduce his Market Rasen winning form with Sean Bowen taking over from the stable's conditional jockey
Observe whether Aeroplane Blonde settles better than usual early on given his tendency to race too freely
Watch Corner Forward's jumping under pressure as he hasn't won over hurdles and needs everything to fall right on his light weight

runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with amateur jockey (5lb claim) for struggling trainer, limited soft ground form from 15 runs

runners_data.name: Esperti
runners_data.note: Recent winner off 8-day turnaround for in-form David Rees, strong soft ground record but needs to overcome hold-up disadvantage

runners_data.name: Swift Jet
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning from hurdles win but poor last chase effort, falls concern after two chase tumbles this winter
runners_data.comment: Fell in first two chases; subsequently won over hurdles but pulled up on latest outing
runners_data.spotlight: Fell in his first two chases (both this winter); bounced back with 14l win over hurdles at Doncaster (3m, good to soft) in February but ran poorly when last in action and is very hard to predict on this return to fences.

runners_data.name: Valirann Gold
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with 3lb claimer who pulled off Fontwell surprise last month, inconsistent but capable when right
runners_data.comment: Produced remarkable late surge to win two starts ago but overall profile is not persuasive
runners_data.spotlight: Produced a remarkable late surge to snatch what had looked an unlikely victory at Fontwell (2m5f, good to soft; blinkers removed) last month but this inconsistent 9yo tends to race lazily nowadays and got going too late when back at Fontwell a fortnight ago; other are much less risky.

runners_data.name: I Ain't Your Mate
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse making handicap debut off 99-day break, strong Irish point form but failed over shorter chase distances
runners_data.comment: Tailed off on chase/handicap debut but may yet deliver on his Irish point promise
runners_data.spotlight: Tailed off when upped to 2m5f for chase/handicap debut at Hereford (soft) in January, but the form of his two Irish point runs in 2024 reads very well and he may yet deliver on that promise under rules.

runners_data.name: Bataillon
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with 7lb amateur but proven class for Hobbs/White, disappointed as favourite last time but easier grade here
runners_data.comment: Beaten favourite last time but remains of interest if judged on Taunton win in January
runners_data.spotlight: Unable to justify warm favouritism when well-held fourth at Wincanton (3m1f, good to soft) last month but will appreciate this ease in grade, and the form of his breakthrough win at Taunton (2m7f, good to soft) has worked out well; big player if back on song.

runners_data.name: Martalmix'jac
runners_data.note: Front-running winner at Ludlow in February with 3lb claimer, stays well but 54-day absence since last run
runners_data.comment: Won from the front at Ludlow in February but is too inconsistent to rely upon heavily
runners_data.spotlight: Kept on well to win from the front at Ludlow (3m, good to soft; front pair clear) in February and remains well handicapped on best of last season's form but he's too inconsistent to rely upon heavily.

runners_data.name: John W Creasy
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who won twice on soft last season but completely out of form this term across five runs
runners_data.comment: Dual chase winner last season but out of sorts this term
runners_data.spotlight: Dual chase winner on slow ground last season (2m/2m3f) but out of sorts this term and has a lot to prove.

runners_data.name: Stadmallen
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse making stable debut off 732-day absence, poor recent pointing form makes him hard to recommend
runners_data.comment: Modest pointer; could be considered only if lively in the betting before rules return
runners_data.spotlight: Seen only once under rules since 2021 and this season's pointing form is very uninspiring; 10lb out of the weights for this stable debut; could be considered only if lively in the betting.

runners_data.name: Ahanaglogh
runners_data.note: Sole front runner for in-form Fergal O'Brien with 5lb claimer, low-mileage 7-year-old with 3m stamina potential untapped
runners_data.comment: Runner-up in both chases (2m5f/2m4f) and could have untapped potential over 3m
runners_data.spotlight: Low-mileage 7yo who came second in his first two chases, the latter at Leicester (2m4f, soft) in February; could have untapped potential over 3m and features prominently in calculations.

races.paceDynamic: Ahanaglogh is the sole confirmed front runner and will set a sustainable gallop without pressure from the flag. The prominent runners (Tommys Charm, Mythe Bridge, Bataillon, Martalmix'jac) will track within striking distance, while the large hold-up contingent (Esperti, Swift Jet, I Ain't Your Mate, Henry Box Brown, Stadmallen) will be anchored at the back on the soft ground. Over this stamina-sapping 3m trip on testing conditions, Ahanaglogh can dictate terms and kick for home turning in, while the hold-up horses face a traffic-laden battle from too far back. This race shape strongly favours front runners and prominent racers who can position close to the pace and avoid the scramble behind.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Ahanaglogh Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Ahanaglogh jumps cleanly and maintains his lead throughout the race.
scenarios.body: The 7-year-old gets an uncontested lead on soft ground over his ideal 3m trip, building an insurmountable advantage as the hold-up horses struggle to close from the rear. His low mileage suggests untapped stamina reserves that could prove decisive.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Takeover
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners close on Ahanaglogh turning for home and engage in a battle.
scenarios.body: Mythe Bridge, Bataillon or Martalmix'jac track the leader perfectly before striking in the final half-mile, benefiting from race position while avoiding the energy-sapping drive from the back. The soft ground aids their staying power in a sustained drive.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Hero Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and the race becomes a sprint from the last fence.
scenarios.body: Esperti or Henry Box Brown find clear runs and produce their finishing kicks when it matters, capitalizing on a crawling gallop that negates Ahanaglogh's advantage. The class and recent form of these hold-up horses tells in a slowly-run contest.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Shock
scenarios.trigger: If the main protagonists falter through mistakes or stamina lapses late on.
scenarios.body: Valirann Gold repeats his Fontwell heroics with another late surge, or I Ain't Your Mate shows his pointing form translates to this longer trip under rules. The handicap mark and race conditions align perfectly for an unfancied runner.

watchPoints.text: Watch for traffic problems affecting the large hold-up contingent (Esperti, Swift Jet, Henry Box Brown, I Ain't Your Mate, Stadmallen) if Ahanaglogh sets modest fractions
Monitor Swift Jet's jumping after falling in his first two chases this winter, any mistake could end his chances
Observe how quickly the prominent group (Mythe Bridge, Bataillon, Martalmix'jac) move into contention turning for home
Check if Ahanaglogh can maintain his gallop beyond 2m4f on his first attempt at 3m under rules
Watch for Esperti handling the quick 8-day turnaround after his recent Chepstow victory

races.name: SWRSL - Dan Ward Handicap Hurdle (Div I)

runners_data.name: Midnight Ginger
runners_data.note: Hold-up mare with class but on a long losing run, needs everything to fall right from her back-of-field style
runners_data.comment: Not discredited when fourth at Warwick 60 days ago; possibilities off a falling mark
runners_data.spotlight: On a long losing run but she wasn't discredited on the back of wind surgery when fourth of six in 2m3f Warwick handicap 60 days ago; possibilities off a falling mark.

runners_data.name: Could Be You
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner making handicap debut with tongue-tie, complete unknown quantity under new connections
runners_data.comment: Yet to show any form under rules; could still go forward for new yard on h'cap debut
runners_data.spotlight: Yet to show any form under rules, pulled up in 2m4f Leicester novice in January on his final run for Ryan Potter; tongue tied on yard/handicap debut and he could still take a step forward given he was placed in Irish points.

runners_data.name: Lemon Leaf
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with strong jockey booking in Sean Bowen, should be well-positioned throughout

runners_data.name: Kellebelle
runners_data.note: Hold-up style showing good recent form, tongue-tie retained and arrives in good nick from Huntingdon third
runners_data.comment: Arrives in good nick since sent handicapping; not out of things in bid for a maiden win
runners_data.spotlight: Arrives in good nick since sent handicapping, third of six at Huntingdon (2m4f) in February; not out of things in her bid for a maiden victory.

runners_data.name: Yourcardismarked
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who fades in the finish, stepping up in trip with tongue-tie may help stamina
runners_data.comment: Did not offer much in three maiden hurdles; bred to be better suited by this longer trip
runners_data.spotlight: Did not offer much in three maiden hurdles (around 2m) this year but this son of Harzand goes handicapping now and is bred to be better suited by this longer trip; tongue-tie is also added.

runners_data.name: Mind Hunter
runners_data.note: Hold-up veteran winless since 2022, long absence of 155 days is a major concern
runners_data.comment: It's now 12 starts since his last success (2022); others are preferred
runners_data.spotlight: It's now 12 starts since his last success (2022) and he came in a below-par fifth of seven in 2m4f handicap at Leicester in November; others are preferred.

runners_data.name: Largy Panic
runners_data.note: Front-running winner last time who can control this tactical race, up 2lb but showed good attitude at Kempton
runners_data.comment: Improved when scoring at Kempton latest; big shout with return to further a likely plus
runners_data.spotlight: Lightly raced 6yo who advanced his form on just his second go in handicap company when scoring at Kempton (2m) 29 days ago; up 2lb but showed a good attitude there and has a big shout with this return to further also a likely plus.

runners_data.name: King Berry
runners_data.note: Prominent runner making handicap debut with tongue-tie, modest form but new headgear might help
runners_data.comment: Well held in three 2m maiden hurdles this year; tongue tied for handicap debut
runners_data.spotlight: Modest form in bumpers (for Ed De Giles) and well held in three 2m maiden hurdles this year, beating one at Newbury last month; tongue tied for his handicap debut with much better required.

runners_data.name: Ferando
runners_data.note: Prominent runner coming off a poor chase effort just 9 days ago, tongue-strap refitted
runners_data.comment: Beat only one in 2m3f handicap chase here nine days ago; tongue-strap is refitted here
runners_data.spotlight: Looks a low-level maiden and beat only one in 2m3f handicap chase here nine days ago; tongue-strap is refitted here.

runners_data.name: Lancier Des Obeaux
runners_data.note: Hold-up maiden making handicap debut with tongue-tie, limited form in three hurdle starts this year
runners_data.comment: Has cut little ice in three maiden hurdles this year; handicap debutant
runners_data.spotlight: Has cut little ice in three maiden hurdles (at up to 2m3f) this year; tongue tied for this handicap debut.

races.paceDynamic: Largy Panic will lead this contest, with Lemon Leaf, King Berry and Yourcardismarked likely to track him in prominent positions through the early stages. The confirmed front runner Largy Panic won't face pressure early, allowing him to dictate a steady tempo over this 2m4f trip on soft ground. The lack of genuine pace pressure means the race will develop into a tactical affair, with the tempo likely quickening from three out as the prominent runners and hold-up horses make their moves. This sustainable early pace strongly favours prominent runners and those who can travel well just behind the pace, as they'll be best positioned to respond when the race develops in earnest.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Largy Panic Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Largy Panic maintains his strong recent form and handles the 2lb rise
scenarios.body: His proven front-running style on this course suits the tactical nature, and Tom Bellamy can control the tempo to perfection. The gelding's winning mentality from Kempton gives him a crucial edge over these largely maiden rivals.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Battle
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners Lemon Leaf and King Berry travel strongly into contention
scenarios.body: Sean Bowen's tactical expertise on Lemon Leaf could prove decisive, while King Berry's tongue-tie debut might spark improvement. Both can sit handy and strike when the pace lifts approaching the business end.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Success
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace proves too strong for the front division
scenarios.body: Kellebelle's recent Huntingdon third shows she's in good nick, and her hold-up style could prove effective if the leaders weaken. Midnight Ginger's class might tell despite her long losing run if the race sets up perfectly.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the market leaders fail to deliver and an unconsidered runner benefits from the pace
scenarios.body: Could Be You's tongue-tie and yard switch could unlock hidden ability on handicap debut. The tactical nature might suit a horse coming from nowhere if the favourites disappoint.

watchPoints.text: Largy Panic must handle the 2lb rise after his Kempton success as he's the only proven winner in the field
Mind Hunter's 155-day absence combined with his long losing run makes him a risky proposition despite the weight drop
Multiple tongue-tie debuts including Could Be You, King Berry and Lancier Des Obeaux could spring surprises
Yourcardismarked's tendency to fade in the finish may be exposed again despite the step up in trip
Kellebelle arrives in the best recent form of the hold-up horses and could benefit if the pace collapses

races.name: SWRSL - Dan Ward Handicap Hurdle (Div II)

runners_data.name: Spanish Dancer
runners_data.note: Prominent runner stepping up in trip after 75 days off, trainer has modest 14-day record but horse looks capable of better in handicaps
runners_data.comment: Has been brought along steadily; steps up in trip for h'cap debut and capable of better
runners_data.spotlight: Has been brought along steadily, fifth of ten in 2m Lingfield novice hurdle in February; steps up in trip now going into handicaps and looks capable of better.

runners_data.name: Royal Rhythm
runners_data.note: Prominent style suits but has been off track 163 days since pulling up here, winless since 2023 despite handy weight
runners_data.comment: Off since pulled up here in November; handily weighted if resurgent after a break
runners_data.spotlight: Winless since 2023 and he's been off the track since pulled up in 3m handicap here in November; handily weighted if resurgent after a break.

runners_data.name: Cumhacht
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse in good form after solid second here in February where winner and third have both won since, yet to break maiden
runners_data.comment: Good second here in February; form franked, so player off same mark in bid for maiden win
runners_data.spotlight: Yet to score but he comes here on the back of a good second of six in 2m handicap here in February; the winner and third there have both gone in since, so he's a player off an unchanged mark.

runners_data.name: Neeps And Tatties
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner who improved to finish second here last month, low-mileage type only up 1lb for that effort
runners_data.comment: Step forward when second over C&D last month; she can go well again nudged up 1lb
runners_data.spotlight: Low-mileage 7yo who took a step forward when second of six in C&D handicap last month; she can go well again nudged up 1lb.

runners_data.name: Lion Of The Desert
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who failed to stay 3m at Chepstow 26 days ago, fades in finish but return to 2m4f should help
runners_data.comment: Still a maiden but he failed to stay in 3m Chepstow handicap 26 days ago; not out of it
runners_data.spotlight: Still a maiden but he failed to stay when ninth in 3m Chepstow handicap 26 days ago; not out of things back in trip.

runners_data.name: Mancero
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse carrying bottom weight, wasn't disgraced at Wincanton 20 days ago despite being set plenty to do
runners_data.comment: Not disgraced when fourth at Wincanton 20 days ago; no forlorn hope from a falling mark
runners_data.spotlight: French hurdles winner; yet to score for his current yard but he wasn't disgraced when fourth of 11 in 2m4f Wincanton handicap 20 days ago given he was set a lot to do; no forlorn hope from a falling mark.

runners_data.name: Forest Spirit
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner returning after 187 days off, poor hurdles record despite being fair Flat winner over 1m4f
runners_data.comment: A fair 1m4f Flat winner but yet to match that form in this sphere; needs to step forward
runners_data.spotlight: A fair 1m4f Flat winner but she's yet to match that form in this sphere, fifth of six in C&D handicap in October; needs to step forward after her absence.

runners_data.name: Jour d'Orage
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse still seeking first win, never-dangerous seventh at Wincanton last month and hard to fancy
runners_data.comment: Never-dangerous seventh in 2m4f Wincanton handicap last month; others appeal more
runners_data.spotlight: Still to get his head in front and he came in a never-dangerous seventh in 2m4f Wincanton handicap last month; others appeal more.

runners_data.name: Whatmakes Honey B
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner who won at Taunton last season but offered little this term, well-held sixth there 28 days ago
runners_data.comment: Has offered little this term, well-held Taunton sixth latest; not easy to make a case for
runners_data.spotlight: Ended last season with a breakthrough win at Taunton (2m3f) but she's offered little this season, a well-held sixth back at Taunton (3m) last month; not easy to make a case for.

races.paceDynamic: Spanish Dancer will make the running with Royal Rhythm likely to track close behind, but neither has the pace to create a punishing gallop over this 2m4f trip on soft ground. The moderate early tempo will allow the field to stay compact through the early stages, with the large hold-up contingent (Cumhacht, Neeps And Tatties, Lion Of The Desert, Mancero, Forest Spirit, Jour d'Orage, Whatmakes Honey B) able to travel comfortably in behind. This honest pace on testing ground strongly favours hold-up horses who can deliver late kicks, as the leaders will be vulnerable to being picked off in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays steady as expected and the soft ground takes its toll on the leaders
scenarios.body: The large pack of hold-up runners will have every chance to wind up late, with the testing conditions suiting those who can finish strongly. Cumhacht and Neeps And Tatties look best placed to capitalize from their recent good form.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runners Steal March
scenarios.trigger: If Spanish Dancer and Royal Rhythm can dictate a slower tempo than anticipated
scenarios.body: The prominent pair could get away with murder if they're allowed to coast in front, making it hard for the hold-up brigade to make up ground in time. Spanish Dancer's trainer form suggests improvement is possible.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Midrace Collapse Scenario
scenarios.trigger: If the early leaders fold tamely leaving a scramble from the back
scenarios.body: The race could develop into a cavalry charge from the rear with several hold-up horses having chances but none establishing a clear advantage. Lion Of The Desert could benefit from the drop back in trip after his Chepstow stamina failure.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Surprise Upset
scenarios.trigger: If one of the lesser-fancied hold-up horses finds significant improvement
scenarios.body: An outsider like Forest Spirit returning from a break or Jour d'Orage finding his first win could shock if the race falls apart completely. This would require the market leaders to underperform significantly.

watchPoints.text: Spanish Dancer could steal this if allowed to dictate his own pace from the front without serious pressure
Royal Rhythm's 163-day absence is a major concern despite his handy racing weight and prominent style
Cumhacht's recent second here looks strong form with the winner and third both scoring since
Lion Of The Desert's tendency to fade in the finish could be costly again if he doesn't improve his stamina
Mancero's bottom weight of 142lbs gives him a significant pull at the weights if he can transfer his French form
